<div class="card-body">
'''You Overestimate Their Chances''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">敵を過大評価しすぎだ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使う。負けた側の戦闘ダメージを３倍にする。２：「我々にもまだ勝算はある」の結果を３倍にする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-279o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「退避だと？勝利を目前にしてか？」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' You Overrate the Enemy.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Use immediately after your opponent initiates a battle. Triple the losing side's battle damage. 2. Triple the result of [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances]].

'''Lore:''' “Retreat? With victory in sight?”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[You Overestimate Their Chances]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
